summary: Join our training course on managing healthcare costs in retirement. Gain essential skills to navigate expenses and ensure a financially secure retirement.
lede: Managing healthcare costs in retirement brings medical expenses, insurance coverage, chronic conditions, and long-term care into the centre of retirement planning. You will learn to identify likely healthcare needs, assess cost drivers, compare insurance options, and account for medical inflation when planning ahead. Hands-on scenarios, simple tools, case studies, and real numbers help you forecast costs and communicate decisions clearly. The course also shows professionals and individuals how to connect healthcare planning with retirement income strategies and benefit design.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals and individuals managing healthcare costs in retirement.
audience: Pension fund trustees and scheme administrators
Financial planners, advisors, and wealth managers
Union, staff association, or employee representatives
modules: The New Reality of Healthcare in Retirement
Understanding Health Insurance and Medical Cover Options
Long Term Care and Catastrophic Health Risk
Integrating Healthcare Costs into Retirement Income Planning
Employer Sponsored Retiree Health Benefits and Policy Design
Public, NGO, and Community Support for Retirees
Behavioral Biases in Healthcare and Retirement Decisions
Communicating and Coaching Around Retirement Healthcare Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of retirement planning and healthcare insurance concepts. Experience in HR, finance, or related fields is beneficial but not required.
